headline: Chilean Energy Stocks Outperform as IPSA Index Suffers Worst Month in Three Years
summary: While Chile's benchmark IPSA index dropped 6.5% during October, a group of domestic Chilean energy companies posted positive monthly returns, defying the broader equity market sell-off.
why: The IPSA tracks major stocks on the Santiago Stock Exchange; energy companies provide defensive dividend yields during downturns.

impacts.name: S&P/CLX IPSA
impacts.why: Broad market weakness dragged the Santiago benchmark down 6.5% despite utility sector gains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reallocation toward defensive power generation equities protected utility stock valuations amid broad benchmark selling.
